question: What dark color is to be contemplated after resorting to the place of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini.
A color is to be contemplated there.
The color is dark and black.
inference: After resorting to the yogini's place, one contemplates a dark black color.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yogini, one contemplates the dark, black color.
